name: Brightwood Grove
summary: West of Darkshire, Brightwood Grove's ruined farms shelter savage Nightbane worgen.

sections.title: A Grove in Shadow
sections.body: Brightwood Grove lies within sight of Darkshire, where ruined farms and fences mark the town's edge. Nightbane worgen have made crude camps among the overgrown clearings and prowl close to town. Their presence threatens Darkshire, so the Night Watch and travelers passing through keep their numbers down to protect the settlement.

faq.answer: Brightwood Grove lies in eastern Duskwood, just west of Darkshire along the main paths.
Savage Nightbane worgen inhabit Brightwood Grove. They have made crude camps in ruined buildings and attack anyone who comes near.

faq.q: Why is the grove dangerous to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Brightwood Grove lies just west of Darkshire, where aggressive worgen packs in the brush threaten town patrols, supply lines, and travelers arriving by road.

faq.q: Are there any friendly settlements in the grove?
faq.answer: No friendly settlements remain in the grove. Its few stone buildings and farmsteads lie in ruins, abandoned to the elements and occupied by roving worgen.

angles.text: Brightwood Grove lies just outside Darkshire's gates. Clearing out its worgen packs helps keep the beleaguered town connected to the west.
The grove's dark thickets make tracking the vicious Nightbane difficult. Stay alert for ambushes behind the tree line.
